notes.title: Egg-citement Found!
notes.content:
This Easter, an egg-cellent friendship blossoms! 
Look who hatched a smile this Easter!!
This game is perfect for all ages...and whole family.

notes.title: Meet Sora!
notes.content:
[b]Happy 1st month birthday to Becca![/b] ...It was 22nd;)
This adorable bunny has been hopping into your hearts for a month now!!

Meet Sora, Becca's once beloved pet! He left her house and never came back... [b]But who knows[/b], maybe he found a whole new adventure out there... amongst the clouds?

notes.title: Hoppy Birthday Becca!
notes.content:
It's been one whole week since Becca hopped into the world, and we're so grateful for all the love and support!

Have you joined Becca on her adorable adventures yet? Meet this cuddly bunny and explore a world of cute stories and heartwarming moments!

notes.title: Becca is out NOW!
notes.content: Get ready to step into the charming world of [b]Becca[/b], a brand new interactive story game released today!
